$comment: The WaveSpeed models this pack offers. Add or remove a model by editing this list — no code. A model is offered only while WaveSpeed's live catalogue (GET api.wavespeed.ai/api/v3/models) lists it at /api/v3/<modelId> and its request schema still carries every field named under `inputs`; its option schema comes from WaveSpeed, and every request's price from WaveSpeed's pricing API (POST /api/v3/model/price), never from this file. What WaveSpeed does not expose lives here: how Dimension's inputs map onto each model's fields, the sentence describing how a price is made up (read from each model's docs page and checked against the pricing API on 2026-10-02), the licence, and the feature tags. The catalogue lists no rigging, retopology or part-splitting model, so every entry produces model3d.

uploads.$comment: Reference images are uploaded to WaveSpeed's storage, which keeps them this long (7 days, per its upload docs and data-retention policy). An upload is reused for half of it.
